svg.title: Launch Manager - Forced Run Target Activation

g.text: Launch Manager - Forced Run Target Activation
Components StateManager and setup_filesystems.sh are Ready.
[Run Target "Running" is invalid (Example: Run Target not configured)]
[Run Target "Full" is invalid (Example: Run Target not configured)]
Process next queued Run Target Activation: Run Target "Running"
[Run Target "Off" is invalid (Example: Run Target not configured)]
Clear request queue (Removes "Full" from the queue).
Wait for ongoing operations to finish
Determine transition plan from current state to "Off"
StateManager and random can be stopped in parallel as they do not depend on each other.
Component setup_filesystems must only be stopped after StateManager is stopped due to the dependency relationship.
[StateManager terminates within the configured shutdown timeout]
[StateManager does not terminate within the configured timeout]
The underlying process is already in state terminated.
Invoke callback: Run Target "Off" successfully activated due to Request
